title: Configuration Management
description: How the app uses Viper for configuration with automatic file creation.

steps.title: Config Structure
steps.description: The Config struct holds the API key and paths to the config directory and file.

steps.title: Config Directory
steps.description: Configuration is stored in ~/.config/wmti/ following XDG base directory specification.

steps.title: Viper Setup
steps.description: Viper handles config loading with defaults, automatic YAML parsing, and writes new config if missing.
